method.launch: Each test project launches a fresh Firefox process with its prefs supplied through firefoxUserPrefs before browser startup.
method.preferenceVerification: Separate fresh persistent-profile probes with the identical launch prefs, followed by clean shutdown and prefs.js inspection. This checks preference values, not generated machine code.
method.jits: Ion and Baseline JIT explicitly disabled. Baseline interpreter, regexp and WebAssembly settings were left at Playwright/browser defaults; this is not a claim that every runtime code-generation path was disabled.
method.network: Calendar/explorer traffic in receipt tests is fulfilled with synthetic responses by existing installNetwork fixture; no live confirmation or Bitcoin mining proof is implied.
method.offline: Existing single-file test uses a file: URL and offline browser context, verifies the known hello e2e SHA-256 digest and zero HTTP(S) requests.
method.worker: Existing worker-evidence tests require one real Worker start and completion with matching input size, byte count, SHA-256 digest, no Worker failures and cross-check status ok/skipped. Negative controls reject evidence for forced fallback and a forged wrong byte count.

fixture.oracle: Node crypto SHA-256 independent of app hashing
